question: Can a local SQLite ledger enforce durable fictional receipt uniqueness, idempotent retry and correction markers across concurrent callers and controlled transaction failures?
baseline: Original fictional six-event replay retained unchanged
negative_controls: two distinct concurrent requests same receipt
limitations: Standalone local storage primitive, not integrated with governance_demo.py
Caller-declared approval ID is not authenticated or checked
No real action or rollback; correction is a fictional marker
Thread concurrency on one SQLite file, not distributed consensus
No signed or tamper-proof audit, power-loss test, or external validation
decision: Keep independent EPMO synthetic evidence at Research / Simulation; no release or stage change
next_experiment: Authenticated fictional sandbox policy gate with approval expiry and stubbed adapter receipts/compensation; then blinded reviewer burden versus manual notes
kill_reframe: Simplify if durable approval policy cannot be enforced or reviewer burden exceeds manual notes
